method: Post-draft prose-style-review and writing-naturalness self-read against exact raw logs, receipt and source manifest
genre: Technical after-task evidence report for R package maintainers
score_reason: Concrete measurements and explicit limits read naturally for a technical report; required section headings and one dense result paragraph add some template feel.
confidence_reason: Self-review of a short technical report, not an independent human judgment.

science_gate_reason: Within this one-fixture scope, the symbolic Bernoulli random-intercept SD model matches the fixture and independent references; the report withholds coverage and broad inference claims.
facts_gate_reason: Numbers, timestamps, hashes, counts and caveats were checked against live-test.log, receipt.json, source manifests, original test/helper and capsule verification output.
references_gate_reason: No external literature or bibliographic claim appears in the report; named code and files were checked locally.
calibration_status: No benchmark controls were used for this self-review; numeric score is an editorial judgment only.
